_comment: Embedding configuration for the RAG system. FROZEN CONFIGURATION, not a variable.
Per the approved decision: the embedding model is a fixed component of the RAG
treatment. The study does not compare embedding models; it compares the resulting
RAG configuration against the BM25 baseline.
Verified live against the OpenAI API on 2026-09-28. See verification block below.
The `dimensions` parameter is deliberately NOT set. Matryoshka truncation would
introduce a free parameter that could be mistaken for tuning. Verified: omitting it
_encoding_format_note: The API accepts only 'float' or 'base64'. 'float32' returns HTTP 400.
This was found by testing, not assumed.

vector_store.name: chromadb
_metric_note: Verified: OpenAI returns unit-normalised vectors (measured L2 norm 0.9999), so
cosine similarity is a plain dot product on the stored vectors and the NumPy
cross-check can compare against Chroma directly without renormalising.

_comment: VALIDATION ONLY. Must never be used to alter, correct, adjust or tune experimental
results. If it disagrees with Chroma, that is a finding to report and investigate,
not a discrepancy to resolve in favour of whichever number looks better.
cross_check.method: exact brute-force NumPy cosine similarity from the stored embedding matrix
assertions: top-k chunk ID set from Chroma equals the set computed by exact NumPy
no stale or duplicated chunk IDs
_valid_at_this_scale_note: The corpus is small enough (hundreds of chunks) that brute force is exact and
instantaneous. No approximate-nearest-neighbour index is in play, so 'exact'
genuinely means exact. At a scale requiring ANN, this reference would weaken, and

_comment: Documented API limits observed in the reference: 8192 input tokens per string;
300,000 tokens summed across all inputs in a single request.
_target_note: Well under the per-request ceiling, so a failure can be retried without risking a
silently truncated batch. Recorded here because the choice affects reproducibility.

_comment: Approved mitigation: store the embedding matrix so re-runs and re-analysis reuse
byte-identical vectors, since the model itself cannot be pinned to a dated snapshot.

verification.method: live call to /v1/embeddings and /v1/models using the account API key
